sections.title: Shipping Coverage
content: Shopizen currently ships across India through reliable courier partners.
We are expanding to international locations soon.

sections.title: Delivery Time
content: Orders are usually dispatched within 24–48 hours and delivered within 3–7 business days depending on your location.
You will receive tracking details once your order is shipped.

sections.title: Shipping Charges
content: Shipping is free for orders above ₹499.
For orders below ₹499, a nominal delivery fee will apply.

sections.title: Order Tracking
content: You can track your order from the ‘My Orders’ section in your Shopizen account or via the tracking link sent by email/SMS.
